title: finding(types,cli): `objectui validate` refuses 79 of the 229 registered component types at `type` — `AnyComponentSchema` has no arm for them, `ai-form-assist` (taught by the plugin-ai README) among them
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect family with named sites, class (a). `reach:` public door, measured. `objectui validate` runs `safeValidateSchema`, which refuses documents of registered, documented component types at `type`. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat #1, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the objectui#10824 dev report (PR objectui#10858, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured (by the objectui#10824 dev, on a BUILT `packages/types` dist)

- `packages/plugin-ai/README.md` "Schema-Driven Usage" teaches `{ type: 'ai-form-assist', showConfidence: true, showReasoning: true }`. `safeValidateSchema` refuses it with `invalid_union` at `type`, and the strict authoring face does the same, so `objectui validate` prints "Schema validation failed" for a registered, documented type.
- It is a family, not a site. Over the 229 bare keys in `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`, a generated list read from the registration calls that `objectui check` uses, **79** are refused at `type` by `safeValidateSchema({ type: KEY })` (one `invalid_union` issue at path `type` each). Lit control: `timeline` is accepted at `type`.
- `ai-form-assist`, `ai-recommendations` and `nl-query` are among the 79. `packages/types/src/ai.ts` declares `AIFormAssistSchema` and its siblings on the TypeScript face, but no zod arm exists in `AnyComponentSchema`.

## Read by this seat (objectui `origin/main` `4aebea00a`)

- `git grep -c ai-form-assist -- packages/types/src/zod/` finds 0 hits. The key is registered at `packages/plugin-ai/src/index.tsx` and listed in `known-schema-types.ts`.
- The mirror-parity ratchet (`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`) tracks declaration↔mirror PAIRS and unmirrored KEYS. It lists no whole declaration that has no mirror at all, so nothing counts this family.

## Why it matters

The published TypeScript face and the registry say an author may write these nodes, and the README teaches them. The validator an author (or an AI) runs refuses them. Either the declaration is not enforced where it is checked, or the type should not be authorable and the README and declaration are wrong. The 79 are not one class: some have a TS declaration, like the AI three, and some may be deliberately unauthorable. The family-E posture on objectui#8284 treats `any`-typed registrations as unauthorable, and objectui#10393 retired the bare `map` key for this same refusal.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Split the 79 by one measurement before any code:
- (i) a published TS declaration exists: owe a zod arm (the mirror gap);
- (ii) no declaration, and the key is meant to be authorable: owe a declaration and an arm, as a capability case;
- (iii) not meant to be authorable: the README and docs that teach it are false, and the registration's authorability should say so.

The objectui#10393 precedent (retire the key, or give it an arm) covers the single-site shape.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #9387), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `AnyComponentSchema` near mirror/missing/no arm: 2 hits, neither a carrier;
- `(no|missing) zod mirror`: 6 hits, all single-key cards and PRs;
- `known-schema-types`: 8 hits, none about validate refusing registered keys;
- `safeValidateSchema` … refuses … registry: 1 hit, objectui#10393 (closed; the single bare `map` site);
- `ai-form-assist`: 0 hits;
- `validator coverage`: 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `safeValidateSchema refuses registered type` · `AnyComponentSchema missing zod arm family` · `objectui validate ai-form-assist invalid_union` · `known-schema-types 79 refused at type`
